cd /workspace/project/src/eywa && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
path='composer.py'; src=open(path).read()
old = """    def topologicalSortUtil(self, v, visited, sorted_order):
        visited[v] = True
        for i in self.graph[v]:
            if not visited[i]:
                self.topologicalSortUtil(i, visited, sorted_order)
        sorted_order.append(v)

    def topologicalSort(self):
        sorted_order = []
        visited = {model: False for model in self.model_to_node}
        for model in list(self.model_to_node):
            if not visited[model]:
                self.topologicalSortUtil(model, visited, sorted_order)
        sorted_order.reverse()
        return sorted_order
"""
new = """    def topologicalSortUtil(self, v, visited, sorted_order):
        \"\"\"Iterative post-order walk over every prerequisite of ``v``.\"\"\"
        stack = [(v, iter(self.graph[v]))]
        visited[v] = True
        while stack:
            node, dependents = stack[-1]
            advanced = False
            for dependent in dependents:
                if not visited[dependent]:
                    visited[dependent] = True
                    stack.append((dependent, iter(self.graph[dependent])))
                    advanced = True
                    break
            if not advanced:
                stack.pop()
                sorted_order.append(node)

    def topologicalSort(self):
        sorted_order = []
        visited = {model: False for model in self.model_to_node}
        for model in list(self.model_to_node):
            if not visited[model]:
                self.topologicalSortUtil(model, visited, sorted_order)
        sorted_order.reverse()
        return sorted_order
"""
assert old in src
open(path,'w').write(src.replace(old,new,1))
